text: Adding structure to a design against a change nobody has asked for, at the cost of an extra type to name and read past, is called ___ generality.
explanation: It is the counterweight to every principle in the chapter. You cannot make every change cheap; you choose which to make cheap based on which you actually expect, and you accept that the others will cost more. The flashcard design's four-file weak point is left in the book unfixed for exactly this reason — the specification said nothing about timing.
